name: Myrmecopterula velohortorum

ecology.substrate: a hanging garden tended by ants

notes: A second, independent ant-farmed lineage, named in 2014 (genus 2020); the garden hangs wrapped in a mycelial veil [29]. Fruit bodies are coral-like in the genus [29]; none is described for this species, so the form is the genus form and no size is given. Central America is entered as NA.
